text:
Capex – Company will spend approximately INR 600 cr to INR 700 cr annually for the next 3 to 4 years.  
Growth – Management expects net sales to grow by more than 20 % over the next 2 to 3 years.  
Export – Export sales will grow substantially in the full year, in line with earlier guidance.  
Operating margin – Company aims to maintain an operating margin in the range of 11 % to 12 % for the coming year.
